intent.caption: Kinetic 3D type headline — A hero headline as dimensional type with staggered kinetic entrance and weighted settle; MSDF text only.

textContent.text: Every calibre begins as a solid billet.

visualSpec.effects: Hero set as MSDF glyph planes (Lora 600), glyph em height 0.62 scene units, one line centered at y=0.4, per-word z offsets front-to-back 0.12 / 0.0 / -0.12 units for parallax depth. kinetic-text on load: per-glyph y +0.35 to 0 and opacity 0 to 1, 700ms each, 60ms stagger left to right, cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1); the final glyph triggers a group weighted-settle, scale 1.04 to 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). Accent underline rule: 2.6 x 0.045-unit plane #ff2a38, emissive intensity 1.2, at y=-0.05 under the hero, scaleX 0 to 1 anchored left over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) starting 120ms after the last glyph lands. Subhead (em height 0.2) fades up (opacity 0 to 1, y +0.2 to 0, 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94)) at y=-0.65; caption kicker at y=1.15 in JetBrains Mono 700 uppercase. Backdrop: 7 x 5.5-unit plane at z=-1.5 with vertical engineered gradient #0b0b10 to #13131a plus 1.5 percent mono grain, no soft blur. Spacing locked to the 0.25-unit rhythm.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Glyphs rise 0.35 units and fade in with a 60ms left-to-right stagger, the line settles with 1.04 overshoot, then the red underline draws left to right.
